replacements.label: replace-prebuild-absence-with-complete-postbuild-validation
replacements.new:
v4_expected_files() {
    printf '%s\n' \
        './CHECKSUMS.md5' \
        './CHECKSUMS.md5.asc' \
        './ChangeLog.txt' \
        './FILELIST.TXT' \
        './PACKAGES.TXT' \
        './extra/PACKAGES.TXT' \
        './pasture/PACKAGES.TXT' \
        './patches/PACKAGES.TXT' \
        './slackware64/PACKAGES.TXT' \
        './slackware64/d/kernel-headers-6.18.45-x86-1.txz' \
        './testing/PACKAGES.TXT'
}

validate_v4_manifest_text() {
    [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || fail 'v4 manifest text validator requires one argument'
    local line digest rel index=0
    local rows=() expected=()
    mapfile -t expected < <(v4_expected_files)
    mapfile -t rows <<< "$1"
    ((${#rows[@]} == ${#expected[@]})) || fail 'v4 manifest row count differs from exact inventory'
    for line in "${rows[@]}"; do
        digest=${line:0:64}
        rel=${line:66}
        [[ $digest =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && ${line:64:2} == '  ' ]] || fail 'v4 manifest record is not canonical SHA-256 text'
        [[ $rel == "${expected[index]}" ]] || fail 'v4 manifest path or order differs from exact safe inventory'
        index=$((index + 1))
    done
}

verify_v4_tree_at() {
    [[ $# -eq 6 ]] || fail 'v4 tree validator requires six explicit arguments'
    local root=$1 manifest=$2 sidecar=$3 expected_manifest_sha=$4 expected_target_sha=$5 expected_owner=$6
    local rel path actual sidecar_expected_sha inventory_count
    local files=() directories=(extra pasture patches slackware64 slackware64/d testing)
    [[ $expected_manifest_sha =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && $expected_target_sha =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && $expected_owner =~ ^[0-9]+:[0-9]+$ ]] || fail 'invalid explicit v4 validation binding'
    [[ -d $root && ! -L $root && $(readlink -f -- "$root") == "$root" ]] || fail 'accepted v4 root is missing or has symlink ancestry'
    [[ ${manifest%/*} == "${root%/*}" && ${manifest##*/} == local-source-v4.tree.sha256 && $sidecar == "$manifest.sha256" ]] || fail 'v4 external manifest pair path drift'
    for path in "$manifest" "$sidecar"; do
        [[ -f $path && ! -L $path && $(readlink -f -- "$path") == "$path" ]] || fail 'v4 external manifest file is missing or unsafe'
        [[ $(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' -- "$path") == "$expected_owner:444" ]] || fail 'v4 external manifest ownership or mode drift'
    done
    [[ $(regular_sha256 "$manifest") == "$expected_manifest_sha" ]] || fail 'accepted v4 manifest SHA-256 drift'
    validate_v4_manifest_text "$(cat -- "$manifest")"
    sidecar_expected_sha=$(printf '%s  %s\n' "$expected_manifest_sha" "${manifest##*/}" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
    [[ $(regular_sha256 "$sidecar") == "$sidecar_expected_sha" ]] || fail 'v4 sidecar is not the exact canonical manifest binding'
    [[ $(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' -- "$root") == "$expected_owner:555" ]] || fail 'v4 root ownership or mode drift'
    for rel in "${directories[@]}"; do
        path="$root/$rel"
        [[ -d $path && ! -L $path && $(readlink -f -- "$path") == "$path" ]] || fail 'v4 required directory is missing or unsafe'
        [[ $(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' -- "$path") == "$expected_owner:555" ]] || fail 'v4 directory ownership or mode drift'
    done
    mapfile -t files < <(v4_expected_files)
    for rel in "${files[@]}"; do
        path="$root/${rel#./}"
        [[ -f $path && ! -L $path && $(readlink -f -- "$path") == "$path" ]] || fail 'v4 required file is missing or unsafe'
        [[ $(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' -- "$path") == "$expected_owner:444" ]] || fail 'v4 file ownership or mode drift'
    done
    # All expected paths exist and have safe types before counting every entry.
    # dotglob includes hidden additions; no untrusted path is split on newlines.
    inventory_count=$(
        shopt -s nullglob dotglob
        count=0
        for directory in "$root" "${directories[@]/#/$root/}"; do
            for entry in "$directory"/*; do count=$((count + 1)); done
        done
        printf '%s\n' "$count"
    )
    [[ $inventory_count == 17 ]] || fail 'v4 tree has missing or unexpected entries'
    (cd -- "$root" && sha256sum -c -- "$manifest" >/dev/null) || fail 'accepted v4 file content verification failed'
    [[ $(regular_sha256 "$root/slackware64/d/kernel-headers-6.18.45-x86-1.txz") == "$expected_target_sha" ]] || fail 'v4 target artifact SHA-256 drift'
    [[ $(cat -- "$root/FILELIST.TXT") == "$(v4_expected_files)" ]] || fail 'v4 FILELIST differs from the exact safe file inventory'
    grep -Fxq 'PGP compatibility marker for Slackpkg checkchangelog only.' "$root/CHECKSUMS.md5.asc" || fail 'v4 compatibility PGP marker drift'
    grep -Fxq 'No cryptographic authenticity claim is made by this file.' "$root/CHECKSUMS.md5.asc" || fail 'v4 compatibility authenticity boundary drift'
    ! grep -Fq 'BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE' "$root/CHECKSUMS.md5.asc" || fail 'v4 compatibility marker impersonates an OpenPGP signature'
}

verify_local_source_v4() {
    verify_v4_tree_at "$LOCAL_SOURCE_V4_ROOT" "$V4_TREE_MANIFEST" "$V4_TREE_MANIFEST_SHA256_FILE" \
        "$EXPECTED_V4_TREE_MANIFEST_SHA256" "$EXPECTED_TARGET_SHA256" '0:0'
}

verify_v4_temporary_outputs_absent() {
    local roots=()
    shopt -s nullglob dotglob
    roots=("$ACCEPTANCE_ROOT"/$V4_TEMP_GLOB)
    shopt -u nullglob dotglob
    ((${#roots[@]} == 0)) || fail 'local-source-v4 temporary build root already exists'
}
replacements.old:
verify_v4_outputs_absent() {
    local roots=()
    for path in "$LOCAL_SOURCE_V4_ROOT" "$V4_TREE_MANIFEST" "$V4_TREE_MANIFEST_SHA256_FILE"; do
        [[ ! -e $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "local-source-v4 output already exists: $path"
    done
    shopt -s nullglob dotglob
    roots=("$ACCEPTANCE_ROOT"/$V4_TEMP_GLOB)
    shopt -u nullglob dotglob
    ((${#roots[@]} == 0)) || fail 'local-source-v4 temporary build root already exists'
}
